title: You Call It God
description: Black stenciled extraterrestrial figure with hands raised to its head holds a white rectangular placard bearing red pixel-font text reading 'YOU CALL IT GOD WE CALL IT A PRANK,' applied to a weathered pale wall. Below the placard, a small black silhouette figure stands beside a line-drawn snowman; vertical tag 'MEME' appears at right edge.
composition: central paste-up with text sign on cream wall
